stem:
Read the list and answer the question that follows.

• Improved water-purification systems

• Improved computing systems

• Improved global search-and-rescue systems

Which statement describes how these improvements were originally developed?

options.label: A
options.text: The government upgraded the infrastructure for telecommunications.

options.label: B
options.text: The government provided tax incentives to automobile companies.

options.label: C
options.text: The government invested funds into aerospace technology.

options.label: D
options.text: The government provided subsidies to agricultural businesses.
